plugins.name: chet
plugins.description: Chet sets up Start, your company's AI workspace, in Google Drive or a local folder, grades its health, and answers questions about your AI host. Content and access come from the Start connector (Google sign-in). v2.0.0.

plugins.name: linkedin-connect
plugins.description: Stages LinkedIn connection invitations for a list of people: finds each profile, skips existing connections, drafts a short note, and opens one Chrome tab per person stopped at the final Send. You click every Send. Needs Claude in Chrome. v1.0.2.
